evidence.title: GXO and Apptronik Expand Partnership to Scale Humanoid Deployment
evidence.excerpt: ‍ GREENWICH, Conn., November 12, 2026 — GXO Logistics, Inc. (NYSE:GXO), the world’s largest pure-play contract logistics provider, todayannounced that it has signed a Letter of Intent (LOI) with AI-powered roboticscompany Apptronik to expand development of Apptronik technologyfor deployment at scale through a Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. “Humanoid robots are the latestevolution of intelligent automation, and their increasing dexterity will makethem one of the most transformative applications of physical AI in logistics,” saidGXO CEO Patrick Kelleher. “GXO has deep experience turning advanced automationinto operational value at scale. Our expanded work with Apptronik builds onthat expertise as we identify and scale the applications where humanoids candeliver the greatest impact for our customers and team members.” “Westarted working with GXO in 2024, and through our partnership we’re definingwhat it takes to put humanoid robots to work in logistics — measured againstreal operational KPIs in live facilities, and delivering real value.
